analogue: Sunlight photolysis of gaseous pinonaldehyde to lower-carbon gas products, tested separately from OH oxidation.
citation: Photooxidation of pinonaldehyde at ambient conditions investigated in the atmospheric simulation chamber SAPHIR
evidence: In the OH-scavenged sunlight run the reported formaldehyde yield was 0.18 ± 0.20 and no acetone formation was observed. Pinonaldehyde itself decayed, and the measured gas products tested the proposed fragmentation mechanism.
difference: V_A is an ensemble, and a single effective loss coefficient neglects parent-specific photolysis frequencies, spectrum changes and branching into other products.
